notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient seen and examined at bedside. 76-year-old male admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.69, creatinine 2.14-2.15, hemoglobin 13.1-13.2, platelets 208, sodium 139, wbc 5.5-6.1; vitals dbp 66-71, heart_rate 77-81, map 87-92, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 127-135, spo2 97-99, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 2.11-2.13, hemoglobin 13.2, platelets 201-208, sodium 139, wbc 5.4-5.7; vitals dbp 66-71, heart_rate 77-82, map 87-91, o2_flow 0, resp_rate 16-17, sbp 128-134, spo2 98, temp 36.7-36.9
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 76-year-old male, length of stay 2 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Chronic kidney disease stage 3. Acute kidney injury ruled out. Follow up with primary care in one week. Chart, labs and overnight events reviewed.
